candidates.change_summary: Change the return value from `ERC721TokenReceiver.onERC721Received.selector` to a different bytes4 value, e.g., `bytes4(0xdeadbeef)`.
Delete the assignment `baseToken = _baseToken;` so the variable never gets set from the argument.
Rewrite the assignment of `baseToken` to a constant `address(0)` instead of the parameter `_baseToken`.
Move the statement `baseToken = _baseToken;` to after `initialized = true;` so the revert check passes but baseToken is never set when a later call is made.
Change the assignment of state variable `nft` from `_nft` to `address(0)`
Change the assignment of state variable `nft` from `_nft` to `msg.sender`
Delete the assignment of state variable `nft` so it retains the previous value (likely the zero address)
Change the assignment of state variable `nft` from `_nft` to `_baseToken`
Replace 'changeFee = _changeFee;' with 'changeFee = 0;' so that the changeFee state variable is set to zero instead of the supplied parameter.
Delete the statement 'changeFee = _changeFee;' so that changeFee retains its default zero value after initialization.
Replace 'changeFee = _changeFee;' with 'changeFee = _changeFee + 1;' so that changeFee is incremented by one from the supplied parameter.
Remove the fee rate too high check by deleting the require statement so any feeRate can be passed
Change the fee rate assignment to store a constant value of 5000 instead of the input parameter
Change the fee rate assignment to store the input feeRate plus 1, altering the final stored value
Change the require condition to _feeRate > 0 so only strictly positive feeRates revert
Remove the assignment `initialized = true;` so the contract never marks itself as initialized.
